title: The Reproducibility Project: Psychology
description: Large-scale replications of psychology studies succeeded only about a third of the time. Low power and publication bias were major causes. The project launched the replication movement.

demo.code:
print("100 studies replicated: 36 significant again")
print("lesson: original power often < 50%")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Mass replication', 'finding': '~36% replicated', 'cause': 'Low power, bias', 'lesson': 'Power matters', 'benefit': 'Movement launched', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'finding', 'cause', 'lesson', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: HARKing (Hypothesizing After Results)
description: Presenting post-hoc findings as a priori hypotheses inflates false positives; replications of HARKed claims fail. The hypothesis must precede the data. Order matters.

print("replication of X: fails")
